The cleaning app

Logging in

The app is at:

  1. Open the app on your phone.
  2. Tap your name.
  3. Tap your PIN. The last number logs you in.

You only do this once. The app remembers you next time.

What to clean today

  1. The app opens on today’s list.
  2. Start at number 1 and work down.
  3. Tap a building to open it.

Check means a quick tidy and re-stock. Full Clean means the whole clean. A green Done means someone has already finished that building.

When you finish a building

  1. Tap the blue button.
  2. Tap Yes, all done.
  3. That is it. The office can see it is finished.

There is nothing to tick and nothing to hand in. Tapped it by mistake? Open the building again and tap Reopen.

If something is broken

  1. Tap Report.
  2. Say where it is and what is wrong.
  3. Tap Send.

Use it for lost property too. The office sees it straight away. You do not have to wait for an answer.
